title: Wake the Sphinx: redrawn by hand
kaylee: The Sphinx, his desert, the sand heap and the old pot are drawn by hand in the Nile's look. The game plays the same.

pictures.title: The Sphinx and his desert
pictures.caption: No generated background: the Nile's sky, sun, clouds and palms. Tap them and they react.

pictures.title: The old pot
pictures.caption: Hand-drawn, with the Nile's lotus on its belly.
